must_rules.title: Evidence provenance & planning honesty
must_rules.evaluation: All LearnerEvidence requires type, summary and confirmation semantics. Provenance requirements are conditional on evidence type; sourceRef is not universally required.
must_rules.fail_message: M15 is not satisfied by the current Lesson IR.
must_rules.repair_hint: Keep unknown/assumption honest. Add traceable provenance for observed/source-based evidence; for planning_assumption/unknown, sourceRef may be null but teacher confirmation is required.

observed_or_source_based_types.require: sourceRef OR equivalent traceable provenance (lessonRef/activityRef/capturedAt appropriate to the evidence type)

hard_checks.message: A key formative checkpoint must include collect -> interpret -> decide -> act -> recheck.
hard_checks.repair_hint: Add interpretation, decision/action branches and a recheck mapped to success criteria.

hard_checks.message: A key formative checkpoint has an action but no recheck.
hard_checks.repair_hint: Add a new-evidence recheck after the intervention.

hard_checks.message: Planning assumption is presented as observed learner evidence.
hard_checks.repair_hint: Change evidence type to planning_assumption, add teacher confirmation, and remove fabricated certainty.

hard_checks.message: Observed/source-based learner evidence must have traceable provenance.
hard_checks.repair_hint: Add sourceRef or equivalent lesson/activity/timestamp provenance.

hard_checks.applies_when: LearnerEvidence.type in planning_assumption|unknown AND requiresTeacherConfirmation != true
hard_checks.message: Planning assumption/unknown evidence must remain explicitly unconfirmed.
hard_checks.repair_hint: Set requiresTeacherConfirmation=true; do not fabricate sourceRef or observed status.

teacher_confirmation_rules.applies_when: learner evidence is unavailable and planning assumptions materially affect differentiation, grouping, threshold, decision rule, required support, or teaching readiness

attention_conflict_rule: Projector and student flow must not both demand high attention at the same time. Explicitly hand off attention before student interaction.

release_gate.logic: BLOCKED if any blocking failure. NEEDS_TEACHER_CONFIRMATION may continue through authoring/design/preview when unknown/assumption provenance is explicit. READY_TO_TEACH and PUBLISH are blocked if any material required confirmation remains unresolved. READY_WITH_WARNINGS if no blockers and confirmations required for release are resolved but material warnings remain. READY if no blockers, no material pending confirmations, and no material warnings.

conditional_feature_validity.observerEvidence_role: Optional feature-level observer note; not equivalent to CIS badge evidence.
conditional_feature_validity.validity_logic: Each C01-C08 feature is validated as a learning feature. No C-rule directly grants a CIS badge.

derivation.differentiation: M08 evidence + observable student access/challenge behavior
derivation.global_intercultural: valid C01 when used + observable student behavior + observer evidence
derivation.digital_citizenship: valid C02 when used + observable student behavior + observer evidence
derivation.assessment_for_learning: M06 + M07 evidence, including responsive action and recheck

cis_badge_eligibility.logic: Badge eligibility is derived independently after learning-quality validation. C03-C08 do not create standalone CIS badges.

path_conventions.time_unit: durationSec for activity runtime; lesson.runtimeMin for lesson total
